name: Interior painting
heading:
Colour that feels
like home.
description: A considered palette can change the way a room feels. Explore interior painting for bedrooms, living rooms and workspaces, from a quiet refresh to a playful accent.
lead: Fresh colour. A more personal space.
summary: Fresh colour for your home or workspace.

name: Exterior painting
heading:
A better first
impression.
description: Bring a fresh perspective to the outside of your home. Discuss your existing surfaces, colour combinations and preparation needs before choosing the right finish.
lead: Thoughtful finishes, from the outside in.

name: Decorative textures
heading:
More depth.
More character.
description: Marble-inspired veining, architectural stone effects, ornamental patterns and softly textured surfaces. Find a direction in our work and talk to us about bringing it to your space.
lead: A surface worth a closer look.
summary: Marble effects, subtle textures and decorative patterns.

name: Wall art & murals
heading:
Your wall.
A work of art.
description: Explore devotional scenes, tree-inspired compositions and sculptural wall features. Share a reference or an idea and discuss the style, scale and surface with our team.
lead: A personal statement, made part of the room.
summary: Murals, stencils and sculptural wall features.

name: Wood finishes
heading:
Details that bring
a space together.
description: Explore finishing options for doors, frames and wooden features. Share the existing surface and the appearance you have in mind so we can discuss a suitable approach.
lead: A considered finish for your wooden features.
summary: Finishing options for doors, frames and wooden details.

name: Wallpaper
heading:
A fresh layer
of personality.
description: Discuss wall coverings for a feature wall or a complete room. Bring a pattern you love, your wall measurements and photographs of the space to start the conversation.
lead: Pattern and colour, chosen around your room.
summary: Patterns and wall coverings to suit your room.
